dev.j3fftw.litexpansion.compat

Class TagCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • dev.j3fftw.litexpansion.compat.TagCompat

  • public final class TagCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Java-8 universal port helper. org.bukkit.Tag and its constants (e.g. WOOL, CARPETS) only exist on MC 1.13+. Referencing them directly throws on 1.8, so this helper reads them reflectively and returns an empty set when the tag is unavailable, letting callers degrade gracefully instead of failing to enable.
